key_reasoning.reason: Touches 4 UI components (Navigation, NavigationExpandButton, NavigationPinnedSection, NavigationProfile) plus the assistants store default — the full Navigation subsystem, across the component and state layers.

Diffstat covers 5 follow-up rounds of fixes (Chrome paint bug, nav min-height floor, pinned-icon alignment, pinned-icon clipping, scroll-jump-on-toggle) found via live browser testing after the original 6-file implementation — symptom reports rather than acceptance criteria defined up front.

Browser-specific rendering workarounds with no exact precedent in this codebase: will-change/transform-gpu vs overflow-y-auto Chrome mis-paint, overflow-anchor:none to stop Chrome's scroll-anchoring jump, an explicit min-height floor compensating for a flex/percentage-height auto-sizing gap. Each fix is documented with a long comment explaining a non-obvious, hard-to-reproduce quirk.
8 files changed, all modified (no new files): 4 Navigation components, 1 store, 3 test files — fits the 8-10 modified / 3+ directories L band.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped: vague/symptom-based acceptance criteria — Chrome-only clipping, overlap, and alignment regressions were discovered iteratively via live browser testing rather than specified up front.
